visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace generic wrappers with semantic tags
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The page works, but it is built from divs with class names. Rewrite it with header, main, section and footer so the structure is in the tags. The content must stay the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
Recipes

Soup

Boil water.

Salad

Chop leaves.

Cook well.

solution.explanation: Class names like "top" and "block" only mean something to the person who wrote them. The tags header, main, section and footer carry the same meaning for every browser and screen reader, and the CSS needs fewer hooks.

checks.label: The recipes are Soup and Salad
